reviews.disposition:
F1: Full coverage-document content review covers every field of all13wiki rows, exact manifest hashes/source communities/queue paths, reader/disposition/character counters, exclusions, totals, historical disk figures and evidence policy. Snapshot2026-10-10T10:51:56.361231+00:00 records115273retained inputs,3598semantic-read receipts,111675not-semantically-read,23separate metadata scope exclusions and111652pending read/scope review. Those sums agree with the13rows. Reader dispositions sum3630 rather than3598: FMA includes23metadata dispositions and Fallout has250dispositions versus241semantic reads. Neither discrepancy justifies raising semantic totals. Excluded-or-zero selections sum2578 and are separate from retained-input scope; empty selection is not absent source. Original JSON/schema and all source identities remain unchanged.

F2: Dark Souls, One Piece and Reverend Insanity have zero semantic reads in this snapshot. DCC1344/1753, Elden474/4811, Skyrim173/5815, Fallout241/55721, HP147/24634, HxH96/1256 and Fate33/6371 retain substantial residue. JJK501/501 and FMA558+23scope exclusions are scoped text receipts with parent review still pending, not integrated cross-series closure. Shadow31/31 is historical old-community integration, with requested current community explicitly uncovered; shadowslave.fandom.com and source shadow-slave.fandom.com must not be flattened into one current acquisition. Shared reader names do not establish active processes or ownership today.

F3: The frozen source counts are historical main-queue bookkeeping, not a refreshed whole-library status. The checkpoint's later October13 records describe machine-move cache loss, later hash-matched Fate/HxH/FMA restoration into r2folders, new JJK/Bleach/Chainsaw Man lanes and paused Fallout/Skyrim/Elden work; it explicitly says global COVERAGE was not recomputed. Those later records qualify the earlier handoff's live-role/cache/disk assertions. Current payload availability, processes, disk and permissions were not checked by this map review. Do not launch stale commands, regenerate frozen inputs, count old healthy-worker labels as liveness, repeat forbidden fetches or infer refetch authority from the historical restoration description.

F4: Retained source manifests, immutable selected-text/original-text fingerprints, supplementary overlapping scope restorations, rejected local-model notes, source-faithfulness repairs, parent-note review and integrated digests are different evidence levels. The reported JJK481pending parent notes, FMA141supplement dispositions, template dependencies, empty-selection/scope repairs and full cross-series ranking remain separate gates in their own recorded snapshots. Hash/length validation can detect damaged receipts but cannot prove every note accurate, every payload read or primary-canon authentication. Fully cached/indexed is not fully read, and scoped full text is not automatically accurate-note review or adoption.

F5: Preserve the useful corrections on source identity/edition, exact clauses and conditions, clock units, actor attribution, missing nested templates and explicit old-versus-requested communities through existing source digests/coverage/checkpoint owners. A secondary wiki source remains secondary even when locally preserved. The historical4GBfloor and4318027776freebytes are not current space or download permission. No new source acquisition, archive restoration, raw-body reading, script execution, worker/thread restart, network call, private source access, gameplay edit, deletion, relocation, commit or push occurs. This closes review of the227-line coverage record, not its111652historically pending source inputs.
